names.note: The heading of days.pravoslavie.ru's name page 2433, «Вевея (Февея, Вивея) Едесская, мц.», with the rank word left off; the page prints Февея and Вивея as variants of the same name, and the day line gives «Вевеи» alone.

death.note: The Russian day line gives «Мчч. Сарвила и Вевеи Едесских (ок. 98-117)» — about 98 to 117 — and its life says only that they suffered «во II веке, при императоре Траяне», in the second century under the emperor Trajan, whose reign those years are. No year of its own is printed, so the interval stands rather than a date.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 октября ст. ст. — «Мчч. Сарвила и Вевеи Едесских (ок. 98-117).»
source.note: No rank is recorded because the line carries no icon. The day prints three service icons, two «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком» and one «Совершается служба с полиелеем», and all three stand in the paragraph above this one, each immediately before its own entry; none of them reaches this line.

attestations.note: The Russian is the only one of the four calendars that keeps this pair. **The identity is held apart from the corpus's existing `bebaia-the-martyr` on this calendar's own authority, not on a reading of the name.** days.pravoslavie.ru's name index gives this martyr page 2433, «Вевея (Февея, Вивея) Едесская, мц.», and the martyr on its 5 September page 2733, «Фивея (Вивея), мц.»; each of the two pages names one day only, and the two lines carry different lives — life1748 for this pair, beheaded, and life1456 for Thathuel and his sister, where the sister is killed by a spear thrust to the neck. Nothing read here joins them.
